summary: The old Khidkiya Ghat rebuilt across 81,000 sq m with an open-air theatre, floating jetty and bathing areas, a helipad and step-free access — the first ghat in Varanasi accessible to differently-abled visitors. Inaugurated 15 November 2024.

summary: India's first urban public-transport ropeway: 3.75 km and five stations from Varanasi Cantt railway station to Godowlia, near the Vishwanath temple. About 150 ten-seat cabins are planned, with a trip time of roughly 16 minutes.
bestTime: Not yet open to the public
agency: National Highways Logistics Management Ltd (NHLML) · built by Vishwa Samudra Engineering
